intent: Teach district and lane attributes, neighbourhood weekly frequency, centre location, Saturday square market, landmark-relative turning, avenue comparison, church front/back and path endpoint/material.
picturePurpose: Original avenue/lane comparison supports a precise picture task; four changing diagrams teach centre, relative turn, church lane position and gate endpoint, with three evidence tasks for attributes and frequency.

transfer.stem: 换成公园、图书馆与金属门，哪组英文保留了三条信息？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
公园中央有一座雕像。在有图书馆的拐角右转。小路尽头是一扇金属门。
词语提示：statue 雕像；park 公园；metal 金属。

options.text: A statue stands at the edge of the park. Turn right at the corner with the library. The path ends at a metal gate.
A statue stands in the centre of the park. Turn right at the corner with the library. The path ends at a metal gate.
A statue stands in the centre of the park. Turn left at the corner with the library. The path ends at a metal gate.

answer.display: A statue stands in the centre of the park. Turn right at the corner with the library. The path ends at a metal gate.

explanation.strategy: 重新核对中央、地标、左右转向与终点材料。

steps.text: 雕像在公园中央：in the centre of the park。
steps.reason: edge是边缘；不能把中心换成边缘。

steps.text: 在图书馆拐角右转：Turn right at the corner with the library。
steps.reason: 新情境是right，不沿用上一句的left。

steps.text: 小路止于金属门：ends at a metal gate。

explanation.pitfall: 换情境后按新地标和新方向判断；不要照抄上一题的左转、木门。
